neighbours.label: the word ' sample(s)' for specimens or sites drawn in a study ("forty soil samples", "sample sites"); weaker on indefinite picks such as 'something' or 'somewhere in the world'
fire: The team gathered sixty water samples from wells around the district.
Nurses took three urine samples from each patient during the trial.
Geologists chose fifty sample points along the northern ridge.
The lab analysed two hundred tissue samples sent by the clinics.
Ecologists marked thirty sample plots inside the old forest.
Divers brought up nine sediment samples from the lake bed.
Surveyors laid out eighty sample squares across the meadow.
The crew stored a dozen ice samples in the ship's freezer.
quiet: The team visited sixty wells around the district that month.
Nurses checked on each patient three times during the trial.
Geologists walked fifty kilometres along the northern ridge.
The lab hired two hundred technicians sent by the agencies.
Ecologists counted thirty old oaks inside the forest.
Divers brought up nine old anchors from the lake bed.
The bakery handed out a free sample of its new rye bread.
The producer built the track around a sample of an old soul record.

notes: Card: no single token (samples, sample, something, times, world, random). Probes: 'Forty sample sites' 1.02, 'soil samples' 0.43, 'about something' 0.74, a free shop sample 0.09, 'at random' inconsistent. Tested on the sample word only; the indefinite side is not in this test.
